note: Clean GitHub windows-latest runner, from bilby.exe --dump-snapshot in CI run 42795132739 (PR #64), scrubbed by Bilby. The three expected findings are true facts about the runner image, not false alarms, so they are listed with reasons instead of being quietened.

expected.reason: GitHub's windows-latest image boots with TESTSIGNING on. It's a real finding on that image and must stay High/High.
The runner image runs Defender with real-time protection off. True on the runner; it would rightly be Needs attention on a home PC.
The runner's provisioning agent (provjobd.exe) runs unsigned from the runner account's Temp folder. True on the runner; worth a look on a home PC.
